name: Haley Stevens
subject: Michigan, I love you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Haley Stevens for Senate
body:
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [To unsubscribe from this email list, please click here.](https://act.haleyformi.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1&akid=3737%2E49239%2EIZei1d)
| | |
---
Null,

As I'm sure you know by now, the result of our primary wasn't what we were hoping for. I know many of you are disappointed. I understand. I am too. But this moment is bigger than all of us, so I want to talk about where we go from here.

Earlier today, I called Abdul El-Sayed and congratulated him. Abdul is a doctor, a community health official, a Rhodes Scholar, and a dedicated Michigander. When we spoke, I wanted to make one thing clear: **he has my full support as he takes on Mike Rogers in the general election.**
This was a rigorous and thorough primary, and the full span of views within the Democratic Party were heard. Yes, it was tough at times, but that's why we have primaries. This is a big tent, there's bound to be disagreement, and that's OK. This is what democracy looks like. This is what America is about.

And this is an important moment in our country's history. It is absolutely critical that we elect Democrats up and down the ballot. We need to re-elect my friends Kristen McDonald Rivet and Hillary Scholten. And we need to win this Senate seat, because Elissa Slotkin deserves a partner like Abdul standing shoulder to shoulder with her in the U.S. Senate. **Elissa and Abdul are gonna get stuff done for Michigan. I know it.**

I've said from the start that this campaign would be a love letter to Michigan, and that I would run through anyone and anything to protect and defend this state. Today’s result does not change that. I'm still all in for the state I love. That's the Michigan way.

So I can tell you this, Michigan: Haley Stevens will be here.
I'll always be working my heart out for you. First up, we gotta bust our tails to beat Mike Rogers. Then we stand up to Donald Trump, stop his cuts to health care, solve our affordability crisis, and make sure Michigan manufacturers are heard in the halls of power.

I'm so proud of our grassroots campaign. I want to thank every single one of you who volunteered, chipped in, knocked on doors, made phone calls, and talked to a friend about this race. Your work mattered. And I am forever grateful to you for believing in me.

To every Democrat: I love you. Even when we disagree. Let's come together.
To Michigan: I love you. I cannot thank you enough for the opportunity to serve you and to run for the Senate.

With grit and endless gratitude,

Haley

name: Voto Latino
subject: Elaine Luria and Eugene Vindman need our help in Virginia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Latinos showed up for a major election in Virginia, and we need to do it again this fall.
#
Peter,
Virginia's primary results are in, and the battle for November is set.
There are two very vulnerable seats, one currently held by Democrat Eugene Vindman in Virginia’s 7th Congressional District and one toss-up seat currently held by Republican Jen Kiggans for Virginia’s 2nd congressional district that Democrats need to flip.
[**If you’re ready to help Voto Latino register, mobilize, and turn out Latino voters across Virginia’s key battlegrounds, will you rush a contribution of $3 right now?**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260805-1.M0YAuE&amount=3&refcode=em20260805-449&t=26&akid=449%2E1366028%2EodeQTr)
If Democrats are going to flip the House and put a real check on Donald Trump, the path runs through two high-stakes Virginia districts.
Winning these two seats is how we’re going to fix the economic crisis we’re in, stop ICE from terrorizing our communities and hold them accountable, and actually build a government that serves us.
Virginia's elections are decided on very thin margins, and Latino voters in this state hold the power to decide who controls Congress. **Our community showed up to deliver historic wins in Virginia last year, and _we need to do it again this November._**
We’re already on the ground registering, educating, and mobilizing Latino voters across Virginia’s key battlegrounds. But scaling our field team before early voting begins requires immediate resources.
**[Will you pitch in $3 right now to fund Voto Latino’s voter turnout efforts in Virginia and help deliver a Democratic House majority this fall?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260805-1.M0YAuE&amount=3&refcode=em20260805-449&t=27&akid=449%2E1366028%2EodeQTr)**

Friend, Thanks to you, **yesterday we won our Democratic primary election with 74% of the vote** , and we now move on to the general election in November. Many of our endorsed candidates also won their Democratic primaries in Michigan, including local, state, and federal-level positions. **Despite a $70 million onslaught of AIPAC and corporate PAC spending against him, Abdul El-Sayed won his race for U.S. Senate!** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvx7QQDKFwkQMBaEt-a9W1TzWe948TVAxWjPJlxDRh0tkVB4nE725m2b--SIgN3MfH75uO9BHr-rerdUix7qJTRB2RW8TlDrlCU_Ry9awEYRf8qNzfZY77nf1Nw5B7IzK_bRybGhjitFX7VuwZ3paHuMc9ygQ-7XUvORAHvv4Z8J1sAEf2w2afpbWyG7XwCpeXZklFQFtKJOl6U7rdydg4YcKQlwPDB6JfD2S0OZ9ST_d1CQvn8tXC7HgvmgAqudvI7K8TPalRNHWG9ly6wrhZPXM70TNl61lFqkdyTmdlT_b6klRCyYtBOKvCYCzrjXlkca9m8ZhOMt0yINTUptH9G/4sx/AdX5vjIjTFqq4X_PfACg6w/h1/h001.YNnXeqDmpXEW0go2mFIsV_Q6DpRQEVSa27-6jXww0Qw) We’ll be getting out the vote for him in my district and across our swing state as he faces the Trump-backed Republican Mike Rogers in November’s general election. Right now, Abdul and Mike are tied in the polls, each at 45% — but AIPAC and corporate PACs will soon flood the airwaves in an attempt to defeat Abdul. [**We need to hit the ground running. Can you split $5 or any amount between Abdul’s and my campaign today, so we start the general election off strong?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvx7QQDKFwkQMBaEt-a9W1TzWe948TVAxWjPJlxDRh0tkVB4nE725m2b--SIgN3MfG-YynGFfCnb55oex9Yg0IaaW398ZebkayxB8kKLzXen708PlEqzXPmeU5jM7TCYk_3vVGOZgU6EicnLnFskEliS48mVQTCdSIwG63yiaTx-h0LD4nTSxTbWxJn260dTIvHJaNTFbX50j3ZR_NkLo9RfpW3E2h-M7bwyk3CKSx9nj5oMg5eyxCTPnDIvsTusiWJdNWK_jfPPd4Uo04QrDiPwd9yUBOV2KDLceCia1dkP1xXoPyX6-GQ8vHhLHCm31qpp0QCmqLlNU2rnTaF0_9G/4sx/AdX5vjIjTFqq4X_PfACg6w/h2/h001.1wn1tpv2Dm8D4O4-d1giAColalZW5G44_2Qkx5bXGx0) | [SPLIT A DONATION TODAY](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvx7QQDKFwkQMBaEt-a9W1TzWe948TVAxWjPJlxDRh0tkVB4nE725m2b--SIgN3MfGzJt3sj3zXqagzO-19q3Qrni3DDR2oUVfuWFgbhtbglA4fJ88syFkhkHfUxR4cTM3Xy_QMypivXE-dBzEy5DPDSFcqooe4QyIRwzgmk8EdhWIhhBuNCASbV-ecHlmkFXR3dqgMYNW-9OsPPfq3eAWHFkCb51-smgnxEatYEuVmN5DuXoPkxN4ZVIBXhafGuZAIc_F8QfDtGid-kapSWYpOMJQbkPS08zr03sXxiDSRhml34FNH0amTHFLXKuKUPIsh1Ns2aVb5ZqTjgg3dMAlV/4sx/AdX5vjIjTFqq4X_PfACg6w/h3/h001.rdNZIqSexdZzhhtzaMAWKOPsGhy5L61LfU40M0PQX6I)

I’m also very excited to share that these two progressive candidates won their Democratic primaries for seats in the U.S. House of Representatives:
* **Climate and housing activist Will Lawrence won his Democratic primary.** We’ll help him flip Congressional District 7 and win this House seat back from a Republican this November, so he can join me in the fight against fascism and corporate polluters such as data centers.
* **Democratic socialist Donavan McKinney won his Democratic primary against the pro-genocide, anti-worker incumbent** in the 13th Congressional District, right next to mine.**** Donavan was also outspent, with AIPAC and corporate PACs backing the multi-millionaire Shri Thanedar — but people power succeeded.

In these primary elections, the many beat the money. We overcame misinformation and attempts to divide and silence us — and we will continue to build a movement demanding human rights and economic, environmental, racial, and social justice for all.
We’ve accomplished so much together over the years, and our work to uplift our communities — and create an economy and society that is responsive to our needs — is far from over. **Affordable groceries, healthcare, housing, utilities, and other basic needs are still out of reach for millions of Americans.**
We’ll continue to grow our progressive power and fight to **get Big Money out of politics** so we can make sure our government represents and serves the American people, rather than billionaires and corporate interests.

name: Stacy Garrity
subject: FW: I sat down with NEPA Farmers. Here's what they told me.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Garrity for PA * 4075 Linglestown Rd PMB 119 * Harrisburg, PA 17112-1020 * USA
body:
Red tape, the death tax, and the fight to keep family farms alive.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ExxOTQOmkOU?e=63ab67bb25&c2id=8377c90e3583a614e646f5b9492ea9fd)
| | | | | | Peter,
Last week, I held our campaign’s first agriculture listening session at Keith Eckel’s farm in Clarks Summit, Lackawanna County. I sat with farmers, legislators, and local leaders to talk about the issues facing the Ag community.
I heard that farming in Pennsylvania gets harder every day. And too often, it’s state government making it harder.
---
|
---
| | Here’s what I heard:
**Jim Barbour** , a third-generation dairy and beef farmer from Susquehanna County, said his farm is looking for state programs to help. His experience? “Everybody says, ‘Oh, there’s grant money everywhere until you go finding it, and then you can’t find it.’” He said the different state offices don’t communicate with each other, and that’s exactly why he supports my plan for a one-stop FARM office.
**Keith Eckel** , former President of the Pennsylvania Farm Bureau and a Lackawanna County farmer, talked about the inheritance tax. Four of his aunts were farmers, and each time one of them passed away, the family had to pay a 15% inheritance tax on the farm. He called it a critical issue that needs to be addressed if we’re serious about preserving agriculture in Pennsylvania.
---
| | | | |
---
| | Senator Lisa Baker, who has co-sponsored bills to eliminate the inheritance tax, said it plainly: when someone loses a family member and then has to make a decision about selling their property to just pay the tax, that is not fair.
We also discussed permitting reform. State Representative Jon Fritz, who has authored legislation to deem permits approved after 45 days, said what every farmer in the room was thinking: **Pennsylvania should be rolling out the red carpet for agriculture, not busting out the red tape.**
This is what leadership looks like.
You show up. You listen. You learn what’s actually happening on our farms.
At the end of the roundtable, I told the group what I believe: cut red tape, get rid of the overregulation, get rid of the death tax, expand markets for Pennsylvania-grown and raised products, and preserve our precious farmland and help grow the next generation of Pennsylvania farmers.
Food security is national security. And Pennsylvania’s farmers are on the front lines.
---

Friends, for a few weeks, we have been emailing about the Trump-endorsed nominee in our district. Well, something interesting happened in MI-08 last night. **Thomas Smith won the Republican nomination and is the man we need to beat in November.** The AP just called the race for Smith. He is winning 50.4% to Amir Hassan’s 32.2% to Al Lemmo’s 16.4%, with 99% of the votes tallied. This is the same Thomas Smith who suspended his campaign three weeks before the Primary to endorse the _third place_ candidate in the race. And he just beat the candidate handpicked by Donald Trump, who earned his __complete and total endorsement.__ This is the only time all cycle President Trump has endorsed in a primary for federal office and lost... and he lost to a guy who quit the race weeks ago. Republicans are in chaos today, but the truth is, they have millions of dollars to spend and this will be a close race regardless of who the Republican nominee is. We’ll do our homework on Smith and report back. In the meantime, here is what we know for certain: \- _**Smith is coming after us.**_ A small business owner, retired General Motors executive, and member of a military family, Smith said last night how excited he is to take the fight to Kristen. Not on our watch.
\- _**The MAGA Machine has its sights on KMR.**_ They’ll give Smith hundreds of thousands of dollars on day 1, and Mike Johnson’s super PAC has already reserved $2.5 million to attack us this Fall. With the RNC’s $100M+ cash advantage over the DNC and hundreds millions more sitting in dark-money super PACs, we know that is just the beginning.
\- _**Mid-Michigan voters trust KMR.**_ They know that she is fighting for them – taking on a corrupt system, banning congressional insider trading, and taking on special interests to lower costs and cut working families’ taxes. # Gary Johnson just endorsed our campaign
---
| | | | | |

Friend,
I've got exciting news: Governor Gary Johnson just endorsed our campaign for governor.
Gary knows what it takes to lead New Mexico with fiscal discipline because he did it himself. Here's what he had to say:
"As New Mexico's former governor, I'd like to think I know what it takes to lead this state with fiscal discipline and common sense. Gregg Hull built a business from the ground up, then spent 12 years proving as Rio Rancho's mayor that experienced leadership delivers real results — safer streets, a growing economy, and a city other communities look to as a model. New Mexico needs that same kind of leadership at the state level, and that's why I'm proud to endorse Gregg Hull for governor."
That's the same leadership I brought to Rio Rancho for 12 years, and it's what I'll bring to Santa Fe.
Endorsements like this build momentum — but they don't pay for TV time, mail, or the ground game we need to win in November. Will you chip in $25 right now to keep it going?

# AIPAC's $30 million wasn't enough
### We followed the money. Michigan voters saw it -- and rejected it.
| | | [Drop Site News](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
| Aug 5
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dropsitenews)
---
As primary results from last night roll in and with midterms around the corner, Drop Site stories are consistently finding their way to the center of the conversation. In cities and districts across the country, our reporting on AIPAC's secret money networks is at the front of voters' minds as they cast their ballots.
In Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed won the Democratic nomination for Senate, William Lawrence secured the nomination in the 7th Congressional District, and Donavan McKinney unseated Rep. Shri Thanedar in the 13th District. Michigan is notable not only as a battleground state, but because of the direct influence AIPAC tried to buy there.
AIPAC spent more than $30 million trying to defeat El-Sayed and elect Haley Stevens -- an effort to protect a self-described "proud pro-Israel Democrat" who famously said "Israel comes to me in my dreams." El-Sayed won anyway. Drop Site covered that spending in real time, tracing where the money came from and what it was being used to shield.
**That is what journalism is supposed to do, to educate the public so they can make the most informed decision possible.** The problem is that we're doing it with a fraction of the resources it deserves. That's where you come in.
Those trying to buy our elections are banking on anonymity. We're asking you to make sure they can't hide. For less than $0.25 a day, your subscription funds the time and resources we need to follow the money and expose AIPAC.
**[Become a paid subscriber today to fund our investigations. For the next 24 hours, we 're offering 20% off annual subscriptions.](https://substack.com/redirect/ef9f7fcb-d343-42eb-9c5f-82399b524fa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[FUND OUR ELECTION COVERAGE - 20% OFF](https://substack.com/redirect/ef9f7fcb-d343-42eb-9c5f-82399b524fa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Your support directly funds this reporting. Not overhead. Not corporate salaries. The work is tedious and unglamorous, tracing dark money through layers of shell companies. But without it, these stories don't get reported, the shell companies stay hidden, and voters go to the polls without knowing who is funding the candidates on their ballot. Drop Site is committed to fulfilling this obligation - to roll up our sleeves, dig through the mud, and uncover the truth. And it's paying off as election season ramps up.
Dave Weigel, a top election reporter for Semafor, said on X, "the power of a negative Drop Site story was more intense than I expected when I started calling around about these primaries."
**There is a simple principle at stake here: voters deserve to know who is trying to buy their representation before they vote. Not after.**
We cover the dark money because the alternative is letting it work in the dark. No interest group gets to spend unlimited money in secret and claim it's good politics at the same time. If AIPAC believes its positions are popular, it should spend openly and let voters decide. When it chooses not to, that choice is itself the story. We're obliged to tell it.
Semafor's Weigel put it plainly. "[Drop Site has] the ability to drive a lot of local high-info voter conversation. A big AIPAC-linked donation now comes with the cost of Drop Site covering it," he wrote.
**[Become an annual subscriber today for 20% off. Your subscription goes straight to our reporting and backs our commitment to hold AIPAC accountable and keep the public informed.](https://substack.com/redirect/ef9f7fcb-d343-42eb-9c5f-82399b524fa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ SUPPORT THIS WORK - 20% OFF](https://substack.com/redirect/ef9f7fcb-d343-42eb-9c5f-82399b524fa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We're asking for your support as we aim to expand our election coverage, deepen our campaign finance investigations, and make sure that every major dark money move in a competitive primary gets the scrutiny it deserves before ballots are cast, this cycle, and the next, and the next.
Drop Site reaches more than 24 million people every month. Every one of those readers gets full access to everything we publish: no paywall, no email wall, no exceptions. We keep it that way because this information belongs to the public, not just those who can afford to pay for it. We do that with a reader-funded model that lets us answer to no one but you. [Help us prove that model works. Every paid subscription enables us to follow the money in the next race. ](https://substack.com/redirect/ef9f7fcb-d343-42eb-9c5f-82399b524fa0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

This election cycle moves fast, and so does the dark money. Paid subscriptions are what allow us to expose it. Thank you for supporting our work and being part of our community.

**Right now, people are hurting at the pump.** Families are being forced to make impossible decisions between putting food on the table, paying their electricity bill, or filling up their tank. And far too many politicians are using gas prices as a political talking point, rather than helping struggling families.

**That's why I'm calling on Washington to take real action and cut the federal gas tax through the end of the year.**

[_**Now, I need you with me. Will you add your name and join me in demanding Washington cut the federal gas tax and deliver relief for working families?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136696156/638284572/634904343?refcode=ITT_ATA_EM_FR_GasTax_260805_T1_1&ms=ITT_ATA_EM_FR_GasTax_260805_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAzNjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTc0YmRjZjktMGY5MS1mMTExLWIzMzctMDAwZDNhMTU1OGNlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=0ubwCd_kofnNcLZGBDvff8lfZXrPKt01EDZRc9QBT6o=&emci=0dfa46c2-d890-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=a74bdcf9-0f91-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=17458827)

In the face of these rising prices, I know Kentuckians expect me to deliver results.

**That’s exactly what I’ve done.** I’ve frozen the state gas tax, stopped a planned hike, and reduced the tax by $0.10/gallon. All told, these measures are estimated to have saved Kentuckians _millions_ at the gas pump.

**Peter, I took action because I saw people struggling, and it’s because my job is to help them. Every dollar I can put back in a Kentucky family's pocket is one more dollar for the things that matter.**

Now, I’m calling on leaders in Washington to do the same. Good government should be about improving people’s lives — here in Kentucky, we’re proven that actions like these can provide real help to people struggling to get by.

At this point in life, I do not get goosebumps as often, or butterflies in my stomach.
But last night, my heart and soul tapped in my body to remind me how special it is to ask for people’s vote, to get that vote, and to earn a nomination to represent hundreds of thousands of people in Congress.
I am truly grateful that tens of thousands of people across 24 counties believed in me and in this campaign enough to do their part. I am proud of the fact that voters in all 24 counties and municipalities of this district voted overwhelmingly to make me the Democratic nominee. And I was particularly moved to see our watch party dominated by young people determined to reclaim their district, their democracy, and their future.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perriello-em?amount=50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perriello-em?amount=50]
For me, this mission is not the nomination. It is not just reclaiming VA-5 for the people who live here. It is a project of reclamation and reimagining. In the shadows of the Blue Ridge where I was born and raised, in the seat first held by James Madison, we must meet this moment of defending the best of our past and dreaming of an even better future.
Like generations of Americans before us, we must protect our defining aspirations of a more perfect Union, of an inalienable right to life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness. And, like the generation of young people driving this campaign’s energy, we must dare to look beyond the constraints of stale politics to meet this moment of AI and emerging powers. We must face down the attacks on our Constitution and communities, and also set a new North Star of an American dream that leaves no region, race or generation behind.
Since I launched this campaign, I've sat down for more than 500 listening sessions across this region. In living rooms, union halls, and church basements, on stoops and sidewalks, at county fairs and homecomings, I have heard the same refrain. A harmony of sorts. People want to get costs down, paychecks up, and common sense back to DC. They also want a system that treats humans with dignity and decency, and they want the powerful to play by the same rules as everyone else.
Nobody I meet expects the folks in Washington to solve every problem in their life. But they have EVERY right to a representative who doesn't go and make things worse .
Folks around here want a representative who fights for us. They are sick of sell-outs who let dark money donors tell them what to do. John McGuire has clearly broken that trust, and busted the wallets of so many families in the district. But voters want more and deserve more than a chance to Fire McGuire. They need a real alternative – a fighter who cares more about right and wrong than right and left and is not afraid to stand up for it.
You have given the people of Virginia’s Fifth that alternative. I take this nomination as a mission. As a sacred chance to restore faith in our democracy, return our Constitutional freedoms and common sense, and reimagine an American dream for an era that will be dominated by AI.
As a good friend noted this week, the path to freedom passes through this district. The path back to sanity passes through this district. The path to hope rooted in reality passes through this district.
I know we can do it, because I've won this seat before by spending time in every precinct and outperforming in every nook and cranny of the district. This time, against a much weaker and more extreme opponent, we already have the momentum. But we cannot rest.
If you're with me, I'm asking you to start this next chapter of our general election with a people-powered contribution today. Every dollar becomes a door knocked, a voter called, a vote banked. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perriello-em?amount=50]

Thank you for putting your trust in me, and for every bit of time, talent, and treasure you give to this fight. I will spend every day of this final stretch earning it.

**My background is a little different than some of my colleagues in Congress.**
I grew up in a working-class family, and I’m the granddaughter of a police officer and the daughter of two teachers. As a child, I had an interest in engineering, which led me to receive a college scholarship to study electrical engineering.
I worked at General Motors before transitioning to running a small business with my husband in Oregon. Then, I went on to serve my community in the Oregon State Legislature.
I was proud to fight for Oregonians in Salem and work to ensure our voices were heard. But I knew I had to do more if I was going to build a better future for the next generation.
That’s why I decided to run for Congress in 2024. It was an extremely competitive race, but with the support of this grassroots team, we flipped OR-05 from red-to-blue — and I became Oregon’s first Black U.S. Representative.
I’m honored to be working for the good people of Oregon’s 5th District in Washington and fighting to deliver practical solutions to the issues impacting our communities — from working to lower costs to protecting affordable healthcare to strengthening public education.
**I’m proud of the work I’ve accomplished, and I’m determined to continue fighting for the next generation in Congress — and I’d appreciate your support.**

clean_body: My background is a little different than some of my colleagues in Congress. = Hi, I’m Janelle Bynum. I’m a mom of four, an engineer, a businesswoman, a former Oregon State Legislator, and a proud Democrat representing Oregon’s 5th District in Congress. = | | = My background is a little different than some of my colleagues in Congress. I grew up in a working-class family, and I’m the granddaughter of a police officer and the daughter of two teachers. As a child, I had an interest in engineering, which led me to receive a college scholarship to study electrical engineering. I worked at General Motors before transitioning to running a small business with my husband in Oregon. Then, I went on to serve my community in the Oregon State Legislature. I was proud to fight for Oregonians in Salem and work to ensure our voices were heard. But I knew I had to do more if I was going to build a better future for the next generation. That’s why I decided to run for Congress in 2024. It was an extremely competitive race, but with the support of this grassroots team, we flipped OR-05 from red-to-blue — and I became Oregon’s first Black U.S. Representative. I’m honored to be working for the good people of Oregon’s 5th District in Washington and fighting to deliver practical solutions to the issues impacting our communities — from working to lower costs to protecting affordable healthcare to strengthening public education. | Peter,
Today marks 99 days since the Supreme Court ruled to reinstate Jim Crow style redistricting in their now infamous Louisiana v. Callais verdict.
In Justice Alito's opinion for the Court's right-wing majority, he argued Louisiana's Congressional map gave too much power to Black voters -- in a state that is 1/3rd black.
Following the decision, MAGA immediately declared a state of emergency, canceled all congressional elections, and rushed segregationist maps through the Louisiana State House to remove Congressman Cleo Fields (D-LA) and disenfranchise Black voters.
It was nothing short of a political lynching and it isn't stopping in Louisiana. Now, Mississippi, is following in Louisiana's footsteps with a Jim Crow style redistricting of its own to remove Black Democratic Congressman Bennie Thompson (D-MS):
---
| | [](https://wkfbo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001T6lqvKobQ2RNN-Lafcn62t8YK2jkPeeCi0p8B3kBvaqg7EPJpMZEokym5P2qfGALNM2m3afbwv5XYt6LKeUEdOBZoqmj_xZFElZCo0cKBuARoBtuDlK7Flxwl7gsn2fQEj9BNXZfaDAA9qrLwD5eUQzgO-2o4DeMeIwlM49oqkGyfVwS1Y0HKlWTzAu8OzYW1EiZsrZf7AZVj4myYJgwloD7WZetG3tl&c=bD8Q5tPBlTN31dS14RS21gy2ThYuDfn749H9xOkxOEzIIQIFiv8Qvw==&ch=_a4orJLY7rm05z5q3aXJ68QU0mrI69p6oEzhQUwrKe8pimJ1kcqUDQ==)
---
And MAGA isn't finished with Louisiana either, removing one Black Congressman wasn't enough. The Calais plaintiffs are now bringing a 2nd case to the US Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit arguing Louisiana's present map, which still contains one Black majority district, must also be invalidated.
If they have their way, they will ensure that Louisiana, and soon the entire South, is stripped of all Black representation at the federal level.
We know what happens when Black people don't have advocates fighting for us in Washington. Look at the rise of Jim Crow after the failure of reconstruction. It starts with removing our representation then they come for our civil rights.
The MAGA playbook is to flood the zone and push as far as they humanly can until they receive push back. If we do not fight back in Louisiana they will not stop.
This November we will have multiple opportunities to fight and we cannot afford to squander any of them. For the first time in nearly a decade we have a Democrat competing for every seat on the ballot -- US Senate, every Congressional seat, all the way down the ballot to our Public Service Commissioner seats.
This is Louisiana's last stand, and with the way things are headed, we may never have an opportunity to defeat MAGA like this again. clean_body: I am ready to win this Special Election, but I need your help. | Fellow Patriot, With less than one week to go, The legacy my brother, Lindsey, built can never be replicated, but I can honor him by working as hard as he did, every single day, for the people of South Carolina. President Trump encouraged me to run in the upcoming Senate Special Election by saying: "Run, Darline, Run!" That endorsement isn't just an honor. It's a call to action. The President knows South Carolina needs a fighter who will finish what my brother started, and he's counting on us to deliver. I intend to earn every vote because that's what this job demands, and that's what South Carolina deserves. But here's the truth: My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years stockpiling campaign cash. I'm new to this. The Special Election Primary is August 11th - just 6 days away. Every dollar raised between now and then determines whether we can compete on the airwaves, get out the vote, and win. There is no "catching up later." This is the moment. President Trump believes in this campaign. Thank you, Darline Graham United States Senator (R-SC) | | Paid for by Darline Graham Majority Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Darline for Senate, Fund for America's Future, Security is Strength PAC, and NRSC. 228 S. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. 18 months into this presidency and the verdict is absolutely clear:
The Trump administration’s blatant disregard for the law is unprecedented in scope and deeply harmful to our country.
It’s bad for businesses, for workers, for families and children and the elderly, for immigrants, for women, for the LGBTQ community, and for our entire nation’s economy.
That’s why my office has filed 82 lawsuits against Donald Trump and his administration in the last 18 months — more than one a week. We’ve been fighting back and holding the most lawless president in American history accountable, and as long as he keeps breaking the law, we'll keep showing up.
And we’re not just filing lawsuits, we’re winning them — at an 83% win rate.
This progress is made possible by the incredible grassroots support behind this movement for accountability and justice for all. If you want to keep it going, will you chip in $25 today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
Through these wins, we've protected $207 billion in federal funding that Trump tried to rip away from mostly vulnerable Californians. Money for public safety, food assistance, schools, clean energy, victims of crime, libraries, museums, and other vital programs. When Trump went after SNAP funding and literally tried to rip food away from hungry Californians, we sued — and we stopped him.
We’ve won consistently and repeatedly in courtrooms all over the country, at every level of the court system, including the U.S. Supreme Court.
We won on Trump's centerpiece economic policy of tariffs. We won on his unlawful deployment of the National Guard to our cities right here in California and across the country. We won over and over again on California's redistricting clapback, Prop 50.
And we won on one of the most fundamental, core Constitutional rights at the Supreme Court: birthright citizenship.
Trump and I were both in the courtroom for that case, and so I witnessed his devastating and humiliating loss when he tried to revoke a constitutional right at the stroke of a pen — something no president has the power to do.
This has been a historic presidency, but not in the way that Trump wants it to be. It's historic in its unlawfulness, its willingness to trample on our Constitution, hurt our economy, drive up prices, and leave the most vulnerable among us out in the cold.
But we knew what was coming, because Trump told us outright on the campaign trail, and Project 2025 spelled it out for everyone to see. So we made a plan, and we were ready from day one.
Over the last 80 weeks, we’ve reaffirmed over and over again: No one is above the law. We do not live in a monarchy. There are clear limits on the president's power, and every time he tries to exceed them, we will hold him accountable.
I remain ready to take on illegal actions and unconstitutional moves Donald Trump makes over the rest of his presidency. And today, I’m asking you to stand with me. Will you contribute $25 to support my re-election campaign and power the work ahead? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]

New York City's socialist Mayor Mamdani just announced taxpayer-funded groceries for New Yorkers. **And here is the kicker - you will need to show some form of ID to verify you are a New Yorker to get them. **

clean_body: ID for free groceries. No ID to vote. Only in New York. | Fellow Patriot, I have to share something with you because I genuinely cannot stop thinking about it. New York City's socialist Mayor Mamdani just announced taxpayer-funded groceries for New Yorkers. And here is the kicker - you will need to show some form of ID to verify you are a New Yorker to get them. So let me get this straight. You need an ID to get into these grocery stores in New York City. But according to the radical left and my opponent Pat Ryan, you should not need one to vote. You truly cannot make this up. Fellow Patriot, more than 80% of Americans support voter ID. Congress passed a bill requiring it along with stopping members from trading stocks while in office. Pat Ryan voted NO on both. He holds a private stake in an AI company with vast government contracts, sits on committees that vote on AI regulation, and voted to keep trading. And he voted against the same voter ID measure that the overwhelming majority of Americans support. I would have voted YES on both. Without hesitation. Hudson Valley families play by the rules. Their congressman should too. Pat Ryan has sold out to the radical left, and it shows in every single vote he casts. body:
How does this guy still have a job???
| | | | |
---
| | | **[Sign:"Fire Doug Burgum for Being an Incompetent Clown, and an Enabler of Trump's Obvious Lies"](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td2e0a343-5aa4-4983-88b7-560d67a0a52d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** If you’ve ever watched a Trump cabinet meeting, pointed at the TV, and shouted, _“Who the f_ ** is that guy?”* the odds are you were pointing at Doug Burgum—the former governor of North Dakota and the guy who somehow looks exactly like the stock photo that came with the $1.99 picture frame you just bought.[](https://default.salsalabs.org/T132e1bb0-3c08-4a58-82bb-55dd3114f0d2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) He’s also managed to become one of the most embarrassingly incompetent interior secretaries in modern American history. And apparently has no problem repeating Donald Trump’s most obvious lies. Oh... and that Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool that’s now the world’s largest mixture of lime Jell-O, snot, and Vulcan blood? Burgum helped make that happen. Oh, and that Lincoln Memorial reflecting pool that is now the world’s largest trough of lime Jello, snot, and Vulcan blood? Burgum was key to making that happen: As secretary of the interior, Burgum oversees the National Park Service and was the point person for the Reflecting Pool renovation. His department:
* Awarded the rushed $14.7 million resurfacing job without competitive bidding.
* Used a contractor whose installation was later found to be flawed.
* Continued defending that contractor as having done a “fantastic job.”
* Decided to use the same company for repairs instead of seeking new bids.
* Apparently withheld or delayed records showing installation problems while the government prosecuted someone for supposed vandalism.

And now comes the truly infuriating part. Even after prosecutors led by Trump superfan Jeanine Pirrot abandoned the vandalism case because the evidence didn’t support it, Burgum is **still** repeating Trump’s false claim that vandals caused the damage. When you’re more full of shit than Jeanine Pirrot, that is one hell of an accomplishment. In short, he’s incompetent, he’s a Trump sychofant, and he apparently couldn’t give a rat’s ass about the truth. [**Add your name, and demand that Burgum be fired.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T64569b65-fa9d-4167-a9ff-8b4b09fdbc89/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

_There are a few ways to think about Iowa. You might imagine America’s 29th state as the land of corn and pigs (20 million hogs can’t be wrong, reads my favorite T-shirt for sale at the Eastern Iowa Airport). _You might also picture Iowa as flat, like a pancake. But you would be wrong. Iowa is not even in the top five flattest U.S. states, which is a fact I was considering last month as I watched Josh Turek size up a daunting set of stairs in a hilly Cedar Rapids neighborhood. After a moment’s consideration, the 47-year-old Democrat, who uses a wheelchair, shook his head, deciding against it. It would be the only house that Turek would skip that afternoon as he knocked on doors in the warm spring sunlight. At all the other homes, he followed the same elaborate routine without appearing to break a sweat: lowering his body out of his chair and onto the ground; hoisting himself backwards up a step using just his arms; yanking the wheelchair up after him; and repeating that until he reached the doorbell, which is when he would announce, “Hi! You might imagine America’s 29th state as the land of corn and pigs (20 million hogs can’t be wrong, reads my favorite T-shirt for sale at the Eastern Iowa Airport). Maybe you associate it with Field of Dreams, Caitlin Clark, or the future birthplace of Captain James T. Kirk. You might also picture Iowa as flat, like a pancake. But you would be wrong. Iowa is not even in the top five flattest U.S. states, which is a fact I was considering last month as I watched Josh Turek size up a daunting set of stairs in a hilly Cedar Rapids neighborhood. After a moment’s consideration, the 47-year-old Democrat, who uses a wheelchair, shook his head, deciding against it. It would be the only house that Turek would skip that afternoon as he knocked on doors in the warm spring sunlight. At all the other homes, he followed the same elaborate routine without appearing to break a sweat: lowering his body out of his chair and onto the ground; hoisting himself backwards up a step using just his arms; yanking the wheelchair up after him; and repeating that until he reached the doorbell, which is when he would announce, “Hi! | | Peter, ballots are still being counted across Eastern Washington, and I wanted to take a moment to say thank you.

We are encouraged by the early results in the race for Washington’s 5th Congressional District. As of 3 pm Wednesday, August 5, things look good with the third-place candidate behind us by over 6 points.

This has been the largest primary field since the founding of our district. Every challenger stepped up determined to make a change for Eastern Washington and I’m honored to emerge with so many voters supporting me.

We’ll continue watching as every remaining ballot is counted, and I’ll keep you updated as we learn more. **But this much is already clear: Eastern Washington is ready for change; November 3rd is less than 100 days away; and we need to be ready.**

The incumbent dramatically outraised and outspent us. He has extreme party leadership and special interests behind him. Yet as the sole Republican in this week’s primary, he so far has taken less than 48% of the vote.

This tells us Eastern Washington’s families, workers, veterans, farmers, and neighbors are ready for a change. They know that our district deserves **more problem-solving, less politics.**

**We’re going to hit the ground running and do what we set out to do from day one:**[**make sure his first term is his last.**](https://us.list-manage.com/2u8mErth6uA?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4)[

We support partners that help rescue children in danger, support survivors on their long road to healing, and fight for laws that protect the innocent. Because rescue is only the beginning. Children need safety, healing and someone to walk with them on the long road ahead. And that is what your support makes possible. Not just escape. But restoration. A future rebuilt. You see, Friend, Sound of Freedom Foundation 's mission is simple: To stop the sale of God 's children. We extend the reach of the Sound of Freedom film, shining a light on how real and widespread child trafficking is and what we must do to stop it. We believe in a future where this evil is gone. A world where every child is safe and truly free. Jesus said, " Whoever welcomes one little child like this in my name welcomes me." (Matthew 18:5) Today you have the chance to be part of that welcome and be part of that light. Your gift today can help: $25 -- Support immediate outreach and response $50 -- Provide critical care and stabilization $75 -- Help relocate and protect a survivor $100 -- Support ongoing care and legal advocacy Because healing takes time. Protection takes people. And freedom takes courage from all of us. You can step in and help rewrite stories like Sara's. Please give as generously as you can today. And please pray... For Sara. For her children. And for every child still waiting for someone to show up. Because God 's children are not for sale. And together... we will not stop fighting for them. For God's Children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

body:
Republicans called it obstruction. Here's what actually happened:
#
Peter,
Last month, Senate Democrats blocked the $1.15 trillion defense authorization bill. Republicans called it obstruction. Here's what actually happened:
Nobody in that bill answered a basic question — why are we still fighting a war in Iran that Congress never voted to authorize?
That's not a technicality. Service members don't get to decide which wars they deploy to. Congress is supposed to make that call, in public, on the record. Instead, Republicans have been letting Trump do whatever he wants. They’ll cut checks for it, but they don’t have the spine to vote on whether it should keep going.
VoteVets has been pushing Democrats to hold the line until that question gets answered — not to block funding for troops, but to force an up-down vote on this before another dollar goes to a war Congress hasn't authorized.
That kind of pressure campaign isn't free. Calls, digital ads, staff time on the Hill — it adds up fast.

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41534%2E3422442%2E1Mi4vX)
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260805_1_ak.fa2Xg9&refcode=em20260805-41534_partner_ms_aes_em_truthtopower&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41534%2E3422442%2E1Mi4vX)
Peter, it's Dr. Abdul El-Sayed. I am so proud to be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan. And now, our general election campaign officially begins.
Sixteen months ago, this campaign launched with a handful of us in a room and one belief: it shouldn't be this hard, in the richest country in the world, to see a doctor, pay your bills, or know your kids will have it better than you did.
**We carried that to every corner of the state. Now there's one job left: beat MAGA Mike Rogers and win a seat that could decide our Senate majority.**
Rogers got a head start. While we fought through an expensive primary, he ran unopposed, with Trump's backing and $45 million in spending building him up. And still, the race is tied. A recent poll has it locked at 45% to 45%.
**This seat is there for us to take. The only question is whether we reach voters before their money does.**
**[Will you split one of the very first donations of our general election between our campaign and Truth to Power? A dollar right now buys the ads that define these races. A dollar in October only answers their attacks. There is no better time to invest than the start.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260805_1_ak.fa2Xg9&refcode=em20260805-41534_partner_ms_aes_em_truthtopower&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41534%2E3422442%2E1Mi4vX)**
[Donate ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260805_1_ak.fa2Xg9&refcode=em20260805-41534_partner_ms_aes_em_truthtopower&t=4&akid=41534%2E3422442%2E1Mi4vX)
And Peter, here's the contrast in this race.
I'm a doctor. Mike Rogers is the guy who introduced the bill that helped Big Pharma flood this country with opioids. More than 600,000 Americans died. He never apologized. Then he took $400,000 from the drug companies that profited.
As Detroit's health director, I spearheaded a program that will cancel up to $700 million in medical debt for 300,000 Michiganders. Rogers spent 30 years in Washington, left up to $14 million richer working for the same corporations he used to regulate.
I trust women to make their own decisions. Rogers voted for a national abortion ban, including one with no exceptions for rape or incest.
**A doctor who answers to Michiganders, or a career politician who has already shown you who he answers to. That's the choice in November.**
Every day we spend playing catch-up is a day their money defines these races before voters hear from us.
**[Split $5 or whatever you can between our campaign and Truth to Power to power us from the very beginning of this general election.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260805_1_ak.fa2Xg9&refcode=em20260805-41534_partner_ms_aes_em_truthtopower&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=41534%2E3422442%2E1Mi4vX)**
[Donate ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260805_1_ak.fa2Xg9&refcode=em20260805-41534_partner_ms_aes_em_truthtopower&t=24&akid=41534%2E3422442%2E1Mi4vX)
This is day one, Peter. I'd be glad to have you with us from the start.
Thank you so much,
Abdul

Former U.S. Congresswoman Katie Porter founded Truth to Power to support the campaigns of her fellow Democrats. Truth to Power supports candidates who will stand up to Donald Trump, fight to lower costs, and protect the environment.

Young Black Americans are being used as cannon fodder by radical leftists. It's time to wake up.

Fighting Radical Communism
Peter,
**Young Black men and women are the shock troops for this color revolution.** They have been enlisted by the communists as the 1st wave and cannon fodder to destroy this nation from within. I am one of them, but there is hope. The hope of a patriot's pulse.
The only reason Black people are loyal to the Leftists and communists is because they tell Blacks that the system is stacked against them and that success is impossible. They use buzzwords like "systemic injustice" and "social death" to describe the current Black experience in America.

Everyone knows about the island. Everyone knows about the ranch.
Almost nobody knows there was a third place -- a house in the middle of America, in a state you'd never think to look. A woman says she was hurt there. It has never been searched. It has never even been asked about.
Ellie Leonard has been reading what almost nobody else reads, and this week she said the quiet part out loud: one man bought a town, and then he bought the state around it. Cliff lives there--and he didn't argue.
Follow the money out of that house and it turns up in a congressman's alibi, a senator's silence about his own daughter, and a check written into a governor's race that's on the ballot this year.
The names are all ones you know. The connection is one you almost certainly don't.

Friend, Being a Democrat doesn't mean giving your own party a pass. It means holding everyone accountable — including your own. We need self-reflection and honesty about the realities of our politics to rebuild trust with people who've stopped believing government can work for them. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/136699472/638296381/28687014?refcode=260805_sfm_accountable_img1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTM4OTdkNi0xYzkxLWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YwW_N0Z_RDcDfr0EY68YemcsaI8ZmZN5JXz7VlG1V_Q=) That's the reason Seth got into this race. body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM4NzcyNzAS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjUyMDAzMzA3OAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Tell the EPA:
Protect Kids and Communities From Heavy Duty Vehicle Pollution!

Trump’s Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is trying to make it even easier
for heavy duty vehicles, including long-haul trucks and buses, to pollute our
air and make us sick. Toxic pollution from heavy duty vehicles is known to cause
asthma, lung cancer, and heart disease, among other illnesses.

This rollback is especially dangerous for kids who are exposed to toxic diesel
pollution on their way to school. It’s a reckless and inhumane move by the EPA, and we need to speak out.

Public comments are open and the EPA needs to hear from you — join LCV in
speaking out for the health and safety of our kids and communities!

Tell the EPA: Protect Kids and Communities From Heavy Duty Vehicle Pollution! https://links.messages.lcv. ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/8wqzCjx_ Peter, Trump is seeking to roll back limits on health-harming tailpipe pollution from
trucks and buses, which will make our air dirtier and our communities sicker.
Toxic pollution from heavy duty vehicles is known to cause asthma, lung cancer,
and heart disease, among other illnesses. What’s more, this rollback is especially dangerous for kids who are forced to
breathe in toxic pollution from diesel buses on the way to school every day.
It’s a reckless and inhumane move by the EPA, and we need to speak out. Add your name and protect people from toxic air pollution >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/_ Too many communities are already suffering from increased air pollution at the

I am fighting tooth and nail to stay at the top of the polls, but as an underdog, the odds are stacked against me. The local Republican movement is standing firm, but we are facing a billion-dollar liberal network that wants us erased.They are terrified because they know I am the only one who can stop their radical agenda from spreading across the nation. It’s been a brutal race and my team and I are giving it all we’ve got. But as long as I have your support, we are not backing down. I need the entire nation to join this fight. I need you to show the left that when they attack one of us, the whole country stands up. Thank you, \- Steve Hilton Authorized by Steve Hilton for Governor 2026 ]()

# **Jonny’s Team Needs** _**YOU**_**🫵**
---
| | Hi Friend,
There are 69 days left until mail-in ballots are sent, 76 days left until early voting, and 90 days until Election Day! Our district is 22,067 square miles. Chip in to help me get our message out before the clock runs out!
The website has been updated to feature our newsletters and a countdown timer.

---

---
| | | | | | | | | | |

## Upcoming This Week
---
|
---
| |
#### **Come meet me in person**

Friday, August 7th
* Hot August Nights - Hosted by Tooele County Democrats. [RSVP here](https://us.list-manage.com/u_qNI0HnJz7?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=8uOtfmVYCktEx_0rKN1vJ0YMeW-VHVhxLR54EkaNiWNlyCAzrVdVUQbqcad-)

Sunday, August 9th
* Dem Bones - Utah Stonewall Democrats Annual BBQ. [RSVP here](https://us.list-manage.com/qcNbEx_evqn?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=7DzuvksXKxSjLweeq77BHx-Ypm8Pph0mQg1P_rsi4NPu65lU-UdoERBobowp)

---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
## What we need & what we did this week
---
|
---
| |
### Volunteers
---
| | Working for a campaign is challenging. Even more so when you are donating your time.
We need to fill some specialty roles as well as have volunteers to accompany us for events, town halls, and canvassers to phone bank and door knock. This is an **ALL HANDS ON DECK** request!
Send an email to [Maria](mailto:volunteer@jonnyutah4congress.com?subject=Interested%20in%20volunteering%20for%20Jonny%20Larsen&body=Full%20name%2C%20phone%2C%20county%20and%20city%20you%20live%20in.%0A%0APlease%20share%20where%20you%20think%20you%20could%20best%20help%20volunteer%20for%20our%20campaign.%20No%20prior%20experience%20is%20needed%20but%20if%20you%20have%20it%2C%20please%20share!), our volunteer coordinator, to find out more.
---
|
---
| |
### KSVC 980AM Radio Interview
---
| | Last week I had a another great interview on KSVC 980AM in Sevier County. You can listen to it on their [website here](https://us.list-manage.com/xq03AV7Bf1m?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=3k4UFb6ofw0apKRk7e073L2n-V8CJrt_fnQgMh89KRuuMpH5gEigsWZhXKBZ). It is listed in the July 2026 section.
After the radio interview, I was joined by the Sevier County Democratic Party at Richfield Park. I met with residents who came for the county’s free lunch program, Summer Lunch in the Park. I spoke with many of them, including a gentleman who aspires to make it to his 100th birthday. He has 6 more years to go. We had a great conversation, and he told me that he use to ride a horse to school.
---
| |
### The Devastating Fires
---
| | Rep. Mike Kennedy recently blamed the U.S. Forest Service for not doing their jobs well enough to fight these fires. In 2025 when he voted to pass the BBB, Kennedy and the rest of our Utah delegation exacerbated this problem. Visit my FaceBook post to read about how he voted to cut funds and staff that ultimately lead to the dire situation we face.
This past Monday evening, I attended the Widemouth 2 Fire Community Meeting in Millard County to hear updates about the fire that has now spread to Sevier County. I am thankful for and praise our firefighters who are working long and tiring shifts to keep everyone safe. They are fighting an uphill battle right now, risking their lives for everyone impacted. A service and self sacrifice for which I have the utmost respect.
Here are some photos from the Widemouth 2 Fire Community Meeting in Millard County.[https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1JLmkckXN1/](https://us.list-manage.com/1AIIRcH_Y8p?e=c29ddb867a&c2id=ae2ec488ed0a92b1bb8171b838f89423&m=c3eLKmAxU108xE6sACtqDk3zVc6QtU2mVIypQ5IIEwIt56eaefst3KcN51JZ)
---
| |
### I Scream For Representation
---
| | Thank you to everyone who joined us for ice cream and discussion. I met new supporters who are eager and excited to join and support the campaign. I got a lot of great feedback from everyone about what is most important to them and their representation in Washington, D.C.
A huge shout out to La Vonne for hosting and to our campaign volunteers for making this event possible. Without you, it would not have been the success it was. I appreciate everything you do. From the bottom of my heart, thank you!

Peter, it's Dr. Abdul El-Sayed. I am so proud to be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan. And now, our general election campaign officially begins.
Sixteen months ago, this campaign launched with a handful of us in a room and one belief: it shouldn't be this hard, in the richest country in the world, to see a doctor, pay your bills, or know your kids will have it better than you did.
**We carried that to every corner of the state. Now there's one job left: beat MAGA Mike Rogers and win a seat that could decide our Senate majority.**
Rogers got a head start. While we fought through an expensive primary, he ran unopposed, with Trump's backing and $45 million in spending building him up. And still, the race is tied. A recent poll has it locked at 45% to 45%.
**This seat is there for us to take. The only question is whether we reach voters before their money does.**
**[Will you split one of the very first donations of our general election between our campaign and Tammy Baldwin's? A dollar right now buys the ads that define these races. A dollar in October only answers their attacks. There is no better time to invest than the start.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20260805-elsayed.oYekXE&amount=5&refcode=em20260805-5581&t=2&akid=5581%2E35263%2El9dnQ3)**

And Peter, here's the contrast in this race.
I'm a doctor. Mike Rogers is the guy who introduced the bill that helped Big Pharma flood this country with opioids. More than 600,000 Americans died. He never apologized. Then he took $400,000 from the drug companies that profited.
As Detroit's health director, I spearheaded a program that will cancel up to $700 million in medical debt for 300,000 Michiganders. Rogers spent 30 years in Washington, left up to $14 million richer working for the same corporations he used to regulate.
I trust women to make their own decisions. Rogers voted for a national abortion ban, including one with no exceptions for rape or incest.
**A doctor who answers to Michiganders, or a career politician who has already shown you who he answers to. That's the choice in November.**
Every day we spend playing catch-up is a day their money defines these races before voters hear from us.
**[Split $5 or whatever you can between our campaign and Tammy Baldwin's to power us from the very beginning of this general election.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20260805-elsayed.oYekXE&amount=5&refcode=em20260805-5581&t=22&akid=5581%2E35263%2El9dnQ3)**

name: Team Newsom
subject: Are you up for trying something new?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
Join an event near your this weekend.
We're creating a new team of supporters and Governor Newsom hopes you'll say you want to be a part of it. But first, we want to be upfront that it's different from anything most campaigns and organizations have done before.
Here's the idea:
This is a "digital" effort designed to help elect Democrats and spread the word about the work Gavin Newsom is doing. But instead of only running ads or posting on our social media channels and hoping it finds the right people, we're asking you to carry a message — in your own words — into the group chats and online communities you're already part of. The neighborhood thread, your Instagram, the alumni Facebook group, the family text chain.
A lot of those spaces aren't political at all. That's the point. They're full of people we have no other way to reach: not on our lists, not clicking our ads, not following anyone's campaign account. The person already in that room is the only one who can get a message in, and the only one who knows how to say it so it doesn't feel out of place.
So the task isn't forwarding talking points or propaganda. **It's taking what we send you and translating it for people you understand better than we do.**
That matters especially for the arguments we care about most. This new team -- we'll call it a Digital Team -- is another way to reach people. And for a lot of them, the only way.
We’re hosting virtual information sessions weekly so you can learn more. You’ll hear about our objectives this year and how you can participate in the Digital Team.
**[So are you up for it? Find a day and time that works for you and join us for an upcoming session.](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/9919?t=1&akid=2990%2E4767699%2ElUCqTm)**

body:

Now we know we'll be almost certainly facing Democrat Carmela Conroy in November. We have only begun to reduce the size of government and root out the waste and fraud that are robbing taxpayers.Thank you again for your support! * * *
This morning I woke up at the crack of dawn to do a hit on Newsmax, and I'll be honest with you -- I was surprised when they asked for my take on the allegations against Max Miller. So many right-wing outlets have spent months pretending this story doesn't exist. But we've reached the point where it's unavoidable. Even MAGA media can't look away anymore.
So I said on their air exactly what I've been saying for months:
Max Miller is a scumbag. He is an abuser. He broke his daughter's collarbone and lied about it. He needs serious help, he has no business serving in the United States Congress, and he should probably be in prison.
And then I said the part they didn't want to hear: the Republican Party tolerates this. Abuse of women is baked into their movement, and they've made their peace with it. There is no cleaner example than what happened yesterday, when Donald Trump stood in front of cameras and once again called Max Miller "a very good person."
Of course he did. Trump carries water for every protege, every loyalist, every sycophant who kisses the ring -- with zero regard for the wreckage those people leave behind. Because Trump himself is a known abuser. He's all over the Epstein files he is working overtime to hide from you. A jury found him liable for sexually assaulting E. Jean Carroll and made him pay her millions. He surrounds himself with unstable, miserable men who hurt people -- Steve Bannon, Corey Lewandowski, the Tate brothers, on and on and on.
Max Miller might as well be another son to him. That is why the Republican Party is terrified to say a single word about what he did to Emily Moreno.**** The only Republican in Congress I've seen say anything is her father -- a sitting United States senator from Ohio -- and even he is holding back.
Think about that. A man's own daughter is allegedly beaten, and her father, a senator, has to measure his words because he's afraid of what the President of the United States might do to him for telling the truth.
Now, say what you want about how my party handled Graham Platner. A lot of mistakes were made. There are Democrats who'd take back plenty of what they said and did. But when push came to shove, when Platner was credibly accused of violence against women, every single Democrat came out and said he had to go. Every one.
Republicans won't even say Max Miller's name out loud.
That's the difference. And that's the country we live in now -- Donald Trump's America, where we shrug and tolerate an absolutely disgusting piece of shit in Congress because the man at the top demands loyalty over decency every single time.
I want the theme of 2026 to be simple: the American people are done letting scumbags run this country. And I don't believe for one second that's a partisan issue. I was glad to see Platner go. I was glad to see Eric Swalwell go. I'll be glad to see every abuser in my own party go too, and there are more we don't know about yet -- we'll learn their names as brave people find the courage to step forward.
I want Max Miller crushed in November. I want Ken Paxton crushed in November -- another scumbag who protected child sex predators and got himself impeached by his own party. They deserve to lose everything.
* * *

* * *
Here's what I know about these men. The ones who put their hands on women, who look the other way while kids get hurt, are never going to have a single idea that makes your life better. They can't. They only care about themselves -- their proximity to power, to money, to influence. They are fundamentally selfish. They do not think about anyone but themselves, and they do not care who they hurt on the way. And they are betting that the system protects them, and that you're too overwhelmed by everything else to notice.
Watch Max Miller and you see it in real time. He's going on television multiple times a day in the worst PR campaign I have ever witnessed, and he looks unhinged doing it. He looks dangerous. He's lying, reaching for the same tired excuses every abuser reaches for. The only reason he hasn't resigned is that the President is holding him up. Trump keeps calling it a family matter, something the family should settle.
The family cannot settle this. This is a political problem for the Republican Party, and more than that, it is a test of moral clarity.
If you can read the allegations -- a little girl's collarbone broken, a toddler telling people that daddy's house is scary -- and you don't feel something turn over deep in your gut, then you are never going to do the right thing on anything. And I think most people understand that. Goddamn it, if there is one thing left in this country we can still agree on, can it please be that we protect our kids? That we don't hand them to predators? Left, right, center -- that should unite every last one of us.
I'm disgusted by what we've learned to tolerate. We've gone numb to the kind of people running our government. But the reckoning coming in November is going to be stark, and these men are going to get exactly what they have earned. Trump won't understand it -- he doesn't have the capacity to grasp what he's done to this country, or to care about the people he's hurt. Fine. Accountability for Max Miller and Ken Paxton and Donald Trump and every name on this list is how we start fixing what is rotten and broken about our politics.
We can get to a better place. We will. It means more people get hurt before we do, and I hate that with everything in me. But I believe it.
So I can't look away. God, some days there is nothing I want more. Nothing would make me happier than to not know what's in the news, to not watch another clip of Max Miller going on TV to attack his ex-wife for telling the truth about abuse he has all but admitted to. I want to look away.
I can't. And I need you not to look away either. I need you in this fight, because in my darkest moments, when this country feels like too much, you're what keeps me in it. I'm exhausted too.
I'm writing this from New York, a few days away from my family. And the only thing I want right now is to get home, wrap my arms around my son, and make sure he feels safe.
That's what matters. That's the ballgame.
Don't look away.

Friends,
I am continually blown away by this team. The grit, tenacity, and unwavering commitment that each of you brings to this fight is truly inspiring. Over the weekend, Team Cait showed up and showed OUT, kicking things off with the opening of our Peekskill campaign office, where over 100 people joined us — from public servants and union leaders to parents and students — all united by the belief that this country, and its values, are worth fighting for.
We then joined the Mount Kisco Rally for Democracy with more than 250 highly motivated Hudson Valley voters, who are sick and tired of Washington corruption. The corruption that our own congressman, Mike Lawler, perpetuates by voting with Trump 100% of the time – and no, that’s not hyperbole.

All in all, we launched 17 canvasses across all four counties this weekend, with over 100 volunteers knocking on over 2,500 doors to talk with voters about what’s at stake in this election. Across the district, people are working harder than ever and are still being squeezed by rising costs. Since Mike Lawler took office, health insurance premiums and energy bills have climbed over 50%, the tariffs he called "a little bit of short-term pain” are costing families nearly $2,000 more a year, and now gas prices are over $4 a gallon because of the reckless war with Iran that he has voted in favor of five times.

These are not coincidences. They are the direct consequences of Mike Lawler’s record — policies he cast the deciding vote for — and Hudson Valley families are paying the price. While he loves to point the finger at everyone but himself, the truth is, when push comes to shove, Mike Lawler looks out for Mike Lawler (and Donald Trump and the corporations and special interests backing his campaign). He’s not looking out for you. I’m running for Congress because Mike Lawler has had four years to serve this district, and for four years he has failed us. In the Army, when you fail to do the job you were entrusted to do and put your own interests ahead of the mission, we call that dereliction of duty, and you get fired. I have spent my career, sixteen years in the Army, six tours overseas, putting my life on the line for every American, no matter how they registered to vote. If elected to be your next representative, I promise to bring that same commitment to Congress every day.
With gratitude and fire,
**Cait Conley**

subject: Thank You For Everything
body:
It's Been So Wonderful Campaigning With You

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/elizabethforvirginia/thank-you-for-everything?e=2f83c585b2)

# _Thank You For Everything, Virginia_
---
| |
**Before I say anything else: thank you. Thank you for every door you knocked, every call you made, every event you attended, and every conversation you had with a neighbor about why this district deserves better. What we built together over these past few months was never just a campaign, it was a community. And that community isn’t going anywhere.****I won’t pretend that the result last night was the one we wanted. But I want to be really clear about something: this loss doesn’t erase what we accomplished. We brought people into politics who had never felt heard before. We stood up against data centers and raised hundreds of suitcases for foster children. We had some of the highest turnout this district has seen in years, and that’s because people felt like their voices mattered. That’s not nothing, that’s the kind of thing that outlasts every single primary result.****So today is to celebrate everything we built - the friendships we made along the trail, the town halls where we showed up and listened, the volunteers who helped this team again and again just because they believed in something better for Virginia. I am so proud of every single one of you, and I will carry this campaign with me for the rest of my life.****I want to congratulate Shannon Taylor on her win. Running for office takes real courage, and I wish her well as she takes on this responsibility to the district. But let’s be honest: our work here isn’t about one candidate. It’s about making sure this district gets a representative who will actually fight for the people who live here. That fight continues, and it will culminate this November.****So here’s my ask: don’t stop the work yet. This district is ready for change, and flipping this seat in November is bigger than any one of us. I’m asking you to stay in it, because that’s how we turn this race into something that will better this entire district. You deserve something more than a representative who doesn’t listen to you, and doesn't understand what you care about, so let’s not give up this fight.****As for me, this is a goodbye to this campaign, but it’s not a goodbye to this work. I’m not done fighting for the things my neighbors deserve: lives they can afford, a better world to raise their kids in, and leaders who will actually work for them. This chapter is closing, but there are more ahead. Stay tuned, this isn’t the last you’ve heard of me.****Thank you for trusting me with this campaign. Thank you for your time, your energy, and your hope. It has been one of the greatest honors of my life to run alongside you.****-Elizabeth**

And it’s worse than ever now. _Citizens United_ was the worst court decision in modern American history. When members of Congress aren’t begging for money from Washington lobbyists, they’re trying to dodge getting carpet-bombed by super PACs. Senators get threatened with millions of dollars of attack ads over the votes they take. And see, _that_ is why things don’t work for ordinary people.
